procedural_matters: GER 150 was represented by Paul Ost.
facts: Cases 102, 103 and 104 were heard together in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b). The decision was published in Case 104.
The decision in Case 104 was given and published on the Official Notice Board on 29/06/2025 at 17:27. GER 150 did not attend the hearing of Case 104.
Philipp Junker, the helm of GER 150, learned of the outcome of the hearing of Case 104 when he received a phone call from the Race Office on 29/06/2025 at 17:56.
GER 150 lodged a request for reopening of Case 104 on 29/06/2025 at 18:35.
conclusions: GER 150’s request to reopen the hearing was filed after the time limit stated in RRS 63.7(b)(2).
decision: The request to reopen the hearing is invalid.
